Search by meaning covers up to twelve passages of every file with text, code and data included. Indexing takes about three times as long as Meaning on documents.

A new depth is applied in the background at once, to the files already indexed (with the background sync paused, at Sync now). Search by name works as soon as the names are in; text and meaning follow. Each other library has its own depth, under Libraries.

What this computer can read
The reader for each kind of file, and the command that installs one this computer lacks.
FILES	READ BY	NOTE
.docx, .pptx, .xlsx	downmark	Read by downmark, with a standard-library reader for any it cannot.
.doc	downmark, LibreOffice	Read by downmark, then LibreOffice.
.pdf	downmark, pdftotext	Read by downmark, then pdftotext. Scanned pages are read by tesseract.
.odt, .ods, .odp	OpenDocument reader, LibreOffice	Read by OpenDocument reader, then LibreOffice: text, tables, slides and speaker notes.
.xls	xlrd, LibreOffice	Read by xlrd, then LibreOffice.
.ppt	olefile, LibreOffice	Read by olefile, then LibreOffice.
images	tesseract	Text in images is read by tesseract.
